## Interfaces

- Contract enums/optional runner fields (check-run-contract) are consumed by se-workflow check when creating check-runs.
- se-workflow check CLI is the producer named by verify-work and close_batch (verify-authority).
- execute-phase per-task commit (task-commit) supplies clean SHAs for dirty-pass refusal defaults.

## Assumptions

- payload_enum rejects illegal result/method at create time.
- CLI shells to adaptive-artifacts; not a second store.
- Parent invokes CLI / writes assessments; subagents return evidence only.

## Invariants

- Check-run = observation from a run; assessment = meaning and routing.
- Manual criteria never go through `check`.
- Hard authority: tdd/check check-runs only via se-workflow check.

## Conflicts

none
